title: Search or Scoring? Diagnosing Why Visual World-Model Planners Fail
title_zh: 搜索还是评分？诊断视觉世界模型规划器为何失败
abstract_en: Visual world models such as DINO-WM and JEPA-WM plan with an optimizer that searches for actions whose predicted outcome has the lowest cost, its distance to a goal image. A plan can thus fail in two ways: the optimizer never tries a good action that the cost would prefer (a search failure), or the cost, computed on predictions, ranks a bad action first (a scoring failure). The two need different remedies, more search or a better model, but a planner does not record which one occurred. We tell them apart by executing the optimizer's candidates, scoring a known solution with the planner's own cost, and comparing costs on predicted and real outcomes. An error model explains when each arises and so how to use retrieved demonstration windows (DemoProp): start the search from them (a warm start) when prediction errors are small, and average them without the model when large errors make the optimizer pick overrated actions. Across four simulated environments and three world models, on short tasks whose goals the planner can represent, PushT and Wall fail mostly by search, while Metaworld and RoboCasa fail by scoring because the cost, sound on real outcomes (AUROC 0.94 on Metaworld), is at chance on predictions (0.54). The diagnosis tells which remedy pays off: a four times larger search lowers the real-outcome cost only where failures come from search (clearly for DINO-WM), and where they come from scoring, averaging the windows without the model solves 127 of 168 new Metaworld tasks, against at most 87 when the model chooses among them. Within PushT, degrading only the model flips which use is better, and our rule, frozen in advance, follows the flip and solves 678 of 960 new episodes, against 530 for the best fixed use.
abstract_zh: DINO-WM 和 JEPA-WM 等视觉世界模型通过搜索动作序列来规划，以预测结果到目标图像的距离作为代价。规划失败有两种原因：搜索失败，即优化器没有尝试本会获得更低代价的好动作；评分失败，即基于预测结果计算的代价反而把坏动作排在首位。论文通过实际执行候选动作、用规划器自身的代价函数给已知可行解打分，并比较预测结果与真实结果上的代价，区分这两类失败。基于预测误差分析，作者提出 DemoProp：误差较小时，用检索到的示范片段热启动搜索；误差较大时，直接对示范片段中的动作求平均，绕过模型评分。在四个仿真环境和三个世界模型中，对于规划器能表示目标的短程任务，PushT 和 Wall 主要受搜索限制，Metaworld 和 RoboCasa 则主要受评分限制。以 Metaworld 为例，同一代价函数在真实结果上的 AUROC 为 0.94，在预测结果上仅为 0.54，接近随机。扩大搜索只在搜索失败主导时降低实际执行结果的代价；而在评分失败主导时，绕过模型直接平均示范动作更有效。
key_points_zh: 诊断方法：执行优化器提出的候选动作，用同一代价函数评估已知可行解，并对照预测结果与真实结果上的评分，以区分搜索不足和评分失真。
将搜索规模扩大到原来的 4 倍，仅在搜索失败主导时降低实际执行结果的代价，DINO-WM 上的改善尤为明显。
在 168 个新 Metaworld 任务中，DemoProp 绕过模型、直接平均示范动作，解决了 127 个；由模型在示范片段中择优则最多解决 87 个。
在 PushT 中，仅降低模型预测质量就反转了两种示范用法的优劣；预先固定的选择规则在 960 个新回合中解决了 678 个，最佳固定用法仅解决 530 个。
